paper.title_en: A ϕ(1020) Comparative Study between MC and Experimental Data for the BM@N Experiment
paper.abstract_en: The aim of this work is a comparative study of ϕ(1020) for the BM@N experiment. Both Monte-Carlo and experimental data were analyzed. Several distributions were considered during this process: residuals in FSD, GEM and ToF400 detectors for the two products of decay of ϕ(1020). Afterwards, necessary corrections were applied to the MC data to minimize its deviation from the experimental one. Finally, the invariant mass distribution was derived from the experimental data.
